summary: PTC Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. to acquire assets primarily related to ST-920, a gene therapy candidate for Fabry disease, for $111 million upfront plus up to $100 million in contingent milestone payments ($80M on FDA accelerated approval, $20M on full approval). PTC was selected as winning bidder in Sangamo's bankruptcy auction. The deal is subject to Bankruptcy Court approval and HSR waiting period expiration. No indemnification; reps and warranties do not survive closing. Watch for court approval and regulatory milestones.
